correctness.rationale: Subtracting phase equations in tau=gt yields x_prime=G(y-x)-G(y), y_prime=G(y-x)-G(x). With Q=-sin+(r/3)sin3, H=Q(y-x)-Q(y)+Q(x) satisfies canonical Hamiltonian equations, as independently checked symbolically. Let u=cos s: G(s)=F_r(u)=4ru³-(1+3r)u. Its derivative 12ru²-(1+3r) is <=0 and only isolated zeroes for -1/3<=r<=1/9, so F_r is strictly decreasing and equilibrium equalities reduce to cos x=cos y=cos(y-x), giving only sync and two splay. Three invariant collision circles bound two triangular disks; H=0 on each boundary and H=±3sqrt3/2 at the unique nondegenerate splay extremum in each disk, Jacobian determinant9/4, trace0. Absence of other critical points and regular-level isotopy imply every nonzero intermediate level is a closed nonstationary periodic orbit. On a collision arc, d_prime=G(d)-G(0)>0; Taylor expansion independently gives (1-9r)d²/2+O(d⁴), and at r=1/9 exact factorization (4/9)(cos d-1)²(cos d+2)=d⁴/3+O(d⁶), yielding the respective inverse-time and cube-root clocks. For r>1/9 the factor (cos d-1)[4r(cos²d+cos d)+r-1] gives cos d=(-1+r^-1/2)/2 and 2 pair clusters per collision circle. This is an all-parameter analytic proof; finite trajectory checks only corroborate.

value.rationale: The sharp perturbation threshold for a structurally meaningful third Fourier harmonic in a natural conservative phase triad controls when the simple two-annulus portrait breaks. The exact change from d(t)~t^-1 to d(t)~t^-1/3 and its leading coefficient is a motivated nonlinear dynamical boundary phenomenon, not a relabeling of known integrability.

final_claim: For three all-to-all identical phase oscillators with even coupling G_r(s)=-cos(s)+r cos(3s), every -1/3<=r<=1/9 has exactly synchrony and two splay equilibria on the phase quotient, and exactly two periodic annuli separated by invariant collision circles. Splay frequency is 3g/2; collision gap obeys gt|d|->2/(1-9r) below 1/9 and gt|d|^3->1 at 1/9. For all 1/9<r<1 six pair-cluster equilibria appear.
